name: Lavria
source:
[url=/c526]St. Irene[/url] the 29th’s personal servant, Lavria is a timid girl who is torn between supporting St. Irene’s beliefs and obeying the orders of the Church ministers to keep St. Irene in check. Her inability to assert herself causes her to be shunned both by St. Irene and the rest of the church.

[From [url=http://utw.me/2011/05/18/aiyoku-no-eustia-vn-review/#more-3112/]UTW Fansubs' review[/url]]
